text:
meera-finance: Heads up — Zenith Labs (private) flagged a midterm support-tier downgrade effective 2026-06-12 but we already invoiced the full platform fee on INV-105901. They want cash refund, partner prefers credit memo. Need path forward before renewal notice Friday.

jon-billing: Which SOW and reseller? I need effective date to run proration.

meera-finance: SOW ZN-22-C. Reseller channel: VertexPartners (rajesh-resellerops). Effective 2026-06-12. Customer prefers refund but says their AP will accept a credit if it says "final settlement".

billing-bot: Metering export: /exports/zenith_217800.csv

billing-bot: CSV preview:
```
date,resource,units,charge_usd
2026-05-01,platform_fee,1,84000
2026-06-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,5200,0
2026-06-12,change_event,1,0
```

lucy-account: Draft calc: EnterpriseElite annual platform fee = $84,000. CorePlus = $48,000. Delta = $36,000. Remaining from 2026-06-12 to 2027-01-01 ~ 6.6 months => prorated credit = 36,000 * (6.6/12) = 19,800.

peter-cs: Customer insists on immediate cash refund due to audit closing. They said credit memo will delay reconciliation.

jon-billing: We can issue either: credit memo CM-217800-01 for $19,800 or a refund check. Refund will require Treasury approval and reverse reseller commission. Credit memo is faster and keeps cash flow intact.

rajesh-resellerops: VertexPartners will want commission protection. If you do a cash refund, we'll have to claw back commission. Partner Ops can waive clawback if legal attaches partner waiver. That takes time.

nora-legal: We can prepare a short partner waiver clause and a customer release: "Acceptance of this credit/refund constitutes full and final settlement of platform fee differential related to the 2026-06-12 support tier change." Need finance lead and partner ops sign-off.

sam-cfo: Recommendation: issue credit memo marked "Final Settlement", amount $19,700 (round down $100 to keep accounting clean) and ask Collections to apply to next invoice or refund on customer request. Approve $19,700. Sam-cfo: signing off.

meera-finance: Customer said they will accept $19.7k as final if we mark as settlement and provide an immediate PDF credit memo. I'll confirm with AP.

jon-billing: Creating provisional credit memo CM-217800-01 for $19,700, status PendingPartnerAck. Notifying VertexPartners and Partner Ops.

rajesh-resellerops: Partner Ops acknowledges. We'll waive clawback for CM-217800-01 provided the memo contains partner waiver language. Sending internal ack now.

jon-billing: Partner ack received. Updating CM-217800-01 to Final and posting to AR. Collections: please apply credit or issue refund only if customer requests and Treasury approves.

lucy-account: Posted accounting memo ZN-22-C_platformfee_adj_217800 and attached settlement text.

meera-finance: I'll send settlement PDF to Zenith AP with subject "Final settlement of platform fee differential" and close once they confirm.

peter-cs: Customer confirmed receipt and acceptance of credit memo PDF. They will let us know if they want a refund vs apply to future invoices.

jon-billing: CM-217800-01 issued, AR updated, partner ops waiver attached. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
